title: FOBO Bike 2 Motorcycle Tire Pressure Monitor System (2 sensors)

comparisons.notes: FOBO Bike 2 TPMS 2-sensor set, black, same GTIN as the Woot listing's ASIN match; in stock, new condition, authorized FOBO dealer.
Part number FM2410, 2 sensors; store data shows available.
FOBO Bike 2 2-wheel kit, black, SKU FOBO-FM2410; store data shows available.

writeup: The FOBO Bike 2 is a motorcycle tire pressure monitoring kit with two Bluetooth 5 sensors that screw onto your valve stems and send pressure and slow-leak alerts to your phone or watch. Woot has the black 2-sensor set (MPN FM2410) new for $34.99, while Lamonster Garage, Brakecrafters and Journey Moto Gear all charge $99. Woot showed only 2 left at this price.
amazon_match_notes: Woot listing ASIN B07QB9ZR24 matches FOBO Bike 2 black 2-sensor TPMS, MPN FM2410, per upstream verified check.
